basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (IIT Kharagpur) has notified 1 vacancy for the Project Research Associate - Research post on a project-based engagement. The tenure is 12 Months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier, with a consolidated compensation upto 56100 depending on qualification and experience. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the educational, experience, and age requirements specified for the position under the project. Possession of minimum qualifications does not guarantee a call for an interview. M.Tech / ME / MDes / MD or equivalent degree; OR B.Tech / BE / MBBS / MA / M.Sc / MCA / MBA or equivalent degree with 2 years relevant experience; OR B.Sc./B.A./B.Com or equivalent degree with 5 years relevant experience. GATE in CSE/IT/AI/DATA SCIENCE is strongly desirable. M.Tech / ME in CSE/IT/AI/DATA SCIENCE will be preferred. This project position provides an opportunity to pursue PhD in CSE.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated compensation is upto Rs. 56,100 per month, determined based on the candidate's qualification and experience. The tenure of the appointment is 12 months or until the termination of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment project at IIT Kharagpur?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the Hussh One Reference Implementation: Personal Consent Handshake Protocol (PHP) with Finance and Wellness Application Agents project under the Department of Computer Science and Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Project Research Associate - Research position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for this position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications online is 28 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification required for the Project Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an M.Tech / ME / MDes / MD or equivalent degree, or a B.Tech / BE / MBBS / MA / M.Sc / MCA / MBA degree with 2 years of relevant experience, or a B.Sc./B.A./B.Com degree with 5 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. Are there any preferred qualifications or desirable tests?
faq.answer: GATE in CSE/IT/AI/DATA SCIENCE is strongly desirable, and candidates with an M.Tech or ME in CSE/IT/AI/DATA SCIENCE will be preferred.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as on the last date of the advertisement, subject to relaxation based on sponsor agency rules if any.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The consolidated compensation is upto Rs. 56,100 per month, depending on qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 0 for General, Male, OBC, Female, and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the tenure of this appointment?
faq.answer: The tenure is 12 months or until the termination of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Does this position offer an opportunity for higher studies?
faq.answer: Yes, this project position provides an opportunity to pursue a PhD in CSE.
